text:
noah: FYI ran into a weird combo: streaming JSON + fncall in the new starter app. Model emitted two newline-delimited JSON objects and our JS sdk's json_mode blew up during onboarding. demo failed.

noah: raw stream chunk:
```
{"cmd":"fetch_account","acct":987}
{"error":"acct_not_found","code":404}
```

noah: error was a JSON.parse over the whole stream in packages/sdk/src/json_mode.js.

mira: that matches an outstanding parity gap. Python client has a line-delimited iterator that yields docs; JS still assumes a single root.

lee: also saw an auth-retry edge: when a 401 triggers retry, our fncall helper re-encodes the tool payload and the tool plugin receives a double-encoded body. Hits in starter-kit oauth examples under flaky auth.

noah: short-term hack: set json_mode: "line_delimited" to avoid throwing. Example JS: `new Redwood({ json_mode: 'line_delimited' })`. Not ideal, validation is weak.

mira: multi-doc parsing avoids the crash but breaks strict schema validation — we only validate the first doc currently. Needs to validate each doc sequentially and surface per-doc validation errors.

noah: i opened an issue with a tiny repro and the failing request id: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-kit/issues/2601

devex-bot: Created issue #2601 in redwood-inference/starter-kit.

lee: proposed quick plan:
1) patch JS parser to mirror python tolerant iterator,
2) add json_mode: "validate_each" to run schema validation per document and return an array of results,
3) add a unit/integration test in starter-kit for auth-retry + streaming to detect double-encode regressions.

mira: ill take the JS parser parity. noah, can you paste the minimal prompt and failing request id into the issue so i can add tests?

noah: done, prompt and id added. thanks y'all.

lee: small note: when we introduce validate_each, gate it behind an opt-in flag for a release cycle. Some integrations expect current single-doc behavior.

mira: agreed. opening a draft PR and will tag owners.

noah: thanks — dropping any other fncall/stream oddities into #2601.
